name: ArcanEdge-AI/coding-agent-playbook-codex
summary: Installable Codex instructions, skills, and role profiles for scoped engineering work, selective delegation, independent review, and validation, with the main agent retaining responsibility for implementation, integration, and final acceptance.
evidence: The Codex edition installs global instructions into AGENTS.md, self-contained skills, and custom agent profiles; its workflow is instruction-driven rather than a separate orchestration runtime.

Global instructions keep implementation, integration, verification, and final acceptance with the main agent, with helpers used only for bounded assignments whose benefit justifies coordination and review effort.
Task-graph orchestration defines dependencies, ownership, acceptance conditions, and verification gates, skips small or linear tasks, and repeats downstream work only when its consumed input changes.

Helper assignments require finite launch and retry allowances, scoped authority, and primary evidence; the main agent inspects returned work before acceptance and stops unchanged retries without progress.

Issue #49 supplies the maintainer's one-line summary and operating-model description. Public evidence includes one historical measured run, without a controlled comparison or claims of current speed, cost, or quality gains.
